items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: We played a gig with Alvin Thomas

ctx.x: Just physically to pull that off.

That’s right. And him being ill man. I mean that was a hell of a feat. That’s right. But you know what? Now Clyde told you about a saxophone player named Alvin Thomas. We played a gig with Alvin Thomas and we didn’t know he had cancer. And he told me, he said, man I was up at the thing and he was playing so much at a jazz festival and he said he was going over.
